title: Australians they must be this time of year
html_source:
Mid-June is winter in Australia.
The first apples of the season are often harvested in early february in Queensland and in northern Victoria. But usually, most of the Australian apple farms don’t start picking till late-february or early-march, even as late as mid-march for the most southern farms of Tasmania. The length of the season will depend on how many varieties the farm is growing, but it’s commonly around 10 weeks. It means that most of the farms are done with their picking by the end of April or the beginning of May.
